subject: Invoice origination & temporary signed-pdf bridge — Northbridge AP onboarding
messages:
From: Emily Rowe <emily.rowe@northbridge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@northbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice delivery & signed terms question

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the intake form — quick follow up from AP. We have two constraints for our go-live on 2026-11-15: 

1) We need invoices to be issued by the vendor (preferred) so our ERP auto-matches; if Redwood prefers our AP to pull, we can discuss API access but that slows our schedule.
2) For the initial billing month we require a signed PDF of payment terms attached to the first invoice for our audit team.

Two questions: can Redwood (a) mark Redwood as the invoice originator (sender) and (b) provide a short-term mechanism for delivering a signed PDF attached to the first two invoices while we finish portal onboarding?

If helpful: attached is our AP acceptance template (ap-acceptance-nb.pdf).

Thanks — Emily
Emily Rowe
Director, Accounts Payable
Northbridge Health

Attachment: ap-acceptance-nb.pdf (PDF)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rowe <emily.rowe@northbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice delivery & signed terms question

Hi Emily — thanks, and congrats on the fast go-live target. 

Short answers: yes on (a) — Redwood can be the invoice originator. For (b) we can do a temporary signed-PDF bridge: we will attach an ephemeral signed payment-terms PDF to the first two invoice emails while Northbridge completes portal enrollment. That PDF will include an issuance timestamp and a one-time token for audit linking.

Two clarifications so we implement correctly:
- Which billing email should receive the PDF & invoice copies? You listed ap-team@northbridge.com — confirm if billing@northbridge.com should also be CC'd.
- VAT/reverse-charge: do you expect any reverse-charge handling for EU-origin services for this account, or is this US-only? If you need VAT tagging we will include the EORI/VAT-ID fields in the UBL metadata.

Looping in Kimberly (billing ops) and Logan (AP integrations) to confirm the transient workflow + sample file format.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Partner Growth — Billing & Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — invoice delivery & signed terms question

Priya / Logan — draft implementation plan below. I can produce the signed PDF and sample e-invoice.

Plan (temporary bridge):
- Invoice originator: Redwood (invoice-from header will be redwood-invoices@invoices.redwood.com).
- Delivery: manual email push (PDF + signed terms) for first two invoice cycles. We will CC ap-team@northbridge.com and billing@northbridge.com if they confirm.
- File formats: PDF visible invoice + UBL/UBL-like XML attached (sample attached: sample-einvoice.xml).
- Signed PDF: we'll use our internal signing cert to produce a timestamped signed PDF. File name: Northbridge_Signed_Payment_Terms.pdf
- TTL: bridge lasts until portal enrolment completion or 2026-12-15, whichever is earlier.

Logan — are there any PO matching headers Northbridge needs (custom invoice reference, PO number in subject) so our email-to-ERP pipeline tags correctly?

Kimberly Park
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample-einvoice.xml (XML)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — invoice delivery & signed terms question

Kimberly — yes, please include the following to maximize match rate on Northbridge side:
- Subject line format: "Invoice Redwood - INV-{invoice_number} - PO:{PO_NUMBER}"
- Header x-northbridge-po: {PO_NUMBER} (custom header) — Emily, can Northbridge confirm the exact header name if they require something else?
- Include these XML tags in the sample-einvoice.xml: <DocumentReference><ID>{PO_NUMBER}</ID></DocumentReference> and <AccountingCustomerParty><PartyIdentification><ID>{NorthbridgeVendorID}</ID></PartyIdentification></AccountingCustomerParty>.

Also: for the signed PDF token we will mirror a hash in the email body so AP can verify signed document integrity without downloading attachments (small UX win).

Logan Wright
AP Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Rowe <emily.rowe@northbridge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice delivery & signed terms question

On Mon, Nov 1, 2026 at 11:42 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Also: for the signed PDF token we will mirror a hash in the email body so AP can verify signed document integrity without downloading attachments (small UX win).

Thanks, team — this all looks good. Confirmations: 
- Please CC billing@northbridge.com on all invoice emails.
- Subject header format and x-northbridge-po header are fine. We'll accept your hash-in-body verification.
- No VAT/reverse-charge applies (US-only).
- We received Northbridge_Signed_Payment_Terms.pdf (attached) and the sample XML — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Next steps from our side: Marcus in AP will confirm the first PO numbers later today; we expect the first invoice for the partial month on 2026-11-15. Please keep the signed-PDF bridge for two invoice cycles.

Appreciate the quick support — Emily
Emily Rowe
Director, Accounts Payable
Northbridge Health

Attachment: Northbridge_Signed_Payment_Terms.pdf (PDF)
